verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a public pricing page at coreweave.com/pricing that describes on-demand and Spot GPU instances with "great pricing," and Spot Node Pools are documented as pay-as-you-go. However, the captured excerpt shows no actual per-GPU-hour figures, so a published self-serve price list is only implied. missing for 10: evidence of explicit per-GPU-hour prices on the public page, coverage of every GPU type, confirmation that no sales contact is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
